notes: Master space = idle.mp4 frame 0 (720 px). verts are continuous px (pixel centres at +0.5; uv = vert / 720). Weights are independent masks, not a partition: head moves skull, face, ears, ossicones (+ margin) and eases out 45 px down the neck; ear_* is an extra rotation about the ear pivot on top of the head; neck runs from the chin into the shawl; body = everything below the head, 0 at the frame bottom; breath = neck base + shawl + chest, 0 at the head and the frame bottom. ear_left = the ear on the image left (her right). pinned verts lie on the frame bottom (keep them still). Orbs run root to crown, then the third eye on her forehead, then the crystal pendant. Depth: 0 far .. 255 near, depth.px_per_level px per level; pivots_depth in the same 0..255 levels. mesh.depth8 / mesh.matte: depth.webp (0..255) and gigi.webp alpha (0..1) sampled at each vertex, for tools and tests.
